name: datetime-input
title: Datetime Input
description: A single-line field that turns phrases like "tomorrow at 5pm" into a real date and time, with a calendar button for picking by hand. Options hide the calendar, the time list, or show both.
use: Users should pick a date and time but you also want typing "tomorrow 5pm" to work.
avoid: Pulls in a natural-language date parser; vague phrases can resolve to the wrong day.
a11y: Calendar button has a hidden 'calendar' label but the input relies on its placeholder; focus outline is stripped. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A slim dark rounded rectangle with a thin grey border, a small square calendar icon button on the left and a long text input filling the rest. Placeholder text is small and grey; a short helper line sits underneath.
behaves: Typing a phrase such as "tomorrow at 5pm" and pressing Enter or leaving the field rewrites it as a formatted date and fills the line below. The border brightens while the field has focus. The calendar button opens a date and time popover.
customise: placeholder, disabled, showCalendar and showTimePicker are props; colours and layout need a source edit.
weight: light: One input, a popover panel and a date library; idle when closed.
